from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
SPEC=json.loads((OUT/'spec.json').read_text()) if (OUT/'spec.json').exists() else None

def arm_transform(q):
    R=np.eye(3); t=np.zeros(3)
    for a,p,v in zip(SPEC['arm']['axis'],SPEC['arm']['position_m'],q):
        p=np.array(p); Q=Rotation.from_rotvec(np.array(a)*v).as_matrix()
        t=t+R@(p-Q@p)
        R=R@Q
    return R,t

def fk(q, point=None):
    R,t=arm_transform(q)
    return R@np.array(point if point is not None else SPEC['arm']['end_effector']['position_m'])+t,R

def camera_pose(proprio,cam='robot_wrist'):
    c=SPEC['cameras'][cam]['pose']; R=np.eye(3); t=np.zeros(3)
    if cam=='robot_wrist': R,t=arm_transform(proprio[6:13])
    B=Rotation.from_euler('z',proprio[2]).as_matrix()
    pos=B@(R@np.array(c['position_m'])+t)+np.r_[proprio[:2],0]
    axes=B@R@np.array([c['right'],c['up'],c['forward']]).T
    return pos,axes

def cloud(res,cam='robot_wrist'):
    p=np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now']); pos,axes=camera_pose(p,cam)
    d=res.depth[cam][-1].astype(float); h,w=d.shape
    f=h/(2*np.tan(np.deg2rad(SPEC['cameras'][cam]['fovy_deg'])/2))
    v,u=np.mgrid[:h,:w]
    rays=np.stack([(u-(w-1)/2)/f,((h-1)/2-v)/f,np.ones_like(u)],axis=-1)
    return (rays*d[:,:,None])@axes.T+pos

def ik(target,q0,down=True,orientation=None):
    target=np.array(target)
    lo=np.array([-np.inf,-2.24,-np.inf,-2.57,-np.inf,-2.09,-np.inf]); hi=-lo
    def fun(q):
        p,R=fk(q)
        orient=R[:,2]-[0,0,-1] if orientation is None else (R-orientation).ravel()
        return np.r_[(p-target)*5,orient if down else np.zeros(3), .004*(q-q0)]
    sol=least_squares(fun,np.clip(q0,lo+1e-6,hi-1e-6),bounds=(lo,hi),max_nfev=500)
    return sol.x,np.linalg.norm(fk(sol.x)[0]-target)

class Driver:
    def __init__(self):
        self.r=Robot(); self.res=self.r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none'); self.p=np.array(self.res.meta['proprio']['now'])
    def save(self,name):
        self.res.save(str(OUT/name)); print('STATUS',self.res.meta); print('EE',fk(self.p[6:13])[0]); return self.res
    def step(self,a,note=''):
        a=np.array(a,dtype=float).reshape(-1,18)
        with (OUT/'actions.jsonl').open('a') as f: f.write(json.dumps({'actions':a.tolist(),'note':note})+'\n')
        self.res=self.r.submit('delta',a,video='none',include_depth=True,note=note)
        self.p=np.array(self.res.meta['proprio']['now'])
        if self.res.done: self.save('terminal'); print('EPISODE ENDED',self.res.meta['reason'])
        return self.res
    def joints(self,target,grip=0,max_steps=100,tol=.015,speed=.07):
        target=np.array(target)
        for i in range(max_steps):
            e=target-self.p[6:13]
            if abs(e).max()<tol: break
            a=np.zeros(18); a[3:10]=np.clip(e,-speed,speed); a[10]=grip
            self.step(a,'joint motion')
            if self.res.done or self.res.meta.get('blocked'): break
        print('JOINTS',i,'error',target-self.p[6:13], 'ee',fk(self.p[6:13])[0])
    def move_ee(self,target,grip=0,max_steps=100,speed=.05,orientation=None):
        q,err=ik(target,self.p[6:13],orientation=orientation)
        print('IK',q,'position error',err)
        if err>.015: raise ValueError('IK unreachable')
        self.joints(q,grip=grip,max_steps=max_steps,speed=speed)
    def base(self,target,grip=0,speed=.06,max_steps=120):
        target=np.array(target)
        for i in range(max_steps):
            e=target-self.p[:3]; e[2]=(e[2]+np.pi)%(2*np.pi)-np.pi
            if np.linalg.norm(e[:2])<.005 and abs(e[2])<.01:break
            a=np.zeros(18); a[:2]=e[:2]*min(1,speed/(np.linalg.norm(e[:2])+1e-9)); a[2]=np.clip(e[2],-.07,.07); a[10]=grip
            self.step(a,'base motion')
            if self.res.done or self.res.meta.get('blocked'):break
        print('BASE',self.p[:3])
    def hold(self,n=3,grip=0):
        a=np.zeros((n,18)); a[:,10]=grip; return self.step(a,'hold/gripper')

def ee_velocity(p):
    q=np.array(p[6:13]);v=np.array(p[13:20]);eps=1e-5
    return (fk(q+eps*v)[0]-fk(q-eps*v)[0])/(2*eps)
